title: Journey Inventory
description: Schema for the journey inventory of a UK commercial bank, cataloguing end-to-end user journeys that cross capability boundaries.

recommended_first_journey.description: The journey recommended as the first to model in detail, with rationale.

id.description: Identifier of the recommended first journey.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this journey is the recommended starting point.

journeys.description: Ordered list of end-to-end journeys for the bank.

id.description: Unique journey identifier in the format JRN-XXX.

name.description: Short human-readable name for the journey.

description.description: One- or two-sentence description of the journey scope and outcome.

triggering_persona.description: Identifier of the primary persona who initiates or is the subject of this journey.

capabilities_touched.description: Top-level capability identifiers (CAP-XXX) involved in this journey.

sub_capabilities_involved.description: Sub-capability identifiers (CAP-XXX.XX) specifically exercised within this journey.

cross_capability.description: True if the journey spans more than one top-level capability.

priority.description: Business and regulatory priority of this journey.

priority_rationale.description: Brief explanation of why this priority level was assigned.

estimated_complexity.description: Estimated implementation complexity: simple (single system, low branching), moderate (multi-system, some branching), complex (multi-system, high branching, regulatory or risk controls).

happy_path_summary.description: Concise description of the ideal end-to-end flow when no exceptions occur.
